title: Disney It’s a Small World Holiday 1994 Ornament – Schmid Sleigh Ride 7th Edition
descriptionText:
Disney Store “It’s a Small World Holiday 1994” Ornament – Schmid Sleigh Ride 7th Edition – Christmas 1980 – Goofy, Donald & Mickey
Condition:
Pre-owned, in original box. Ornament shows normal light wear/aging consistent with vintage pieces (see photos). Box has some shelf wear but overall presents well. Please review all images for exact condition.
Description
Add a nostalgic touch to your holiday décor with this charming Disney Store “It’s a Small World Holiday 1994” collectible Christmas ornament.
This vintage bulb features classic Disney characters Goofy, Donald Duck, and Mickey Mouse enjoying a festive “Sleigh Ride” scene. The ornament is marked “Christmas 1980” and is part of the Schmid 7th Limited Edition series.
Comes in its original 1994 Disney Store box, making it perfect for collectors or gifting.
Features
Official Disney Store Release (1994)
Schmid – 7th Limited Edition “Sleigh Ride”
Features Goofy, Donald Duck & Mickey Mouse
Dated Christmas 1980
Original box included
Made in USA
Great for Disney collectors or holiday décor enthusiasts
Item Details
Brand: Disney / Schmid
Character(s): Goofy, Donald Duck, Mickey Mouse
Theme: Christmas / Holiday
Type: Ball Ornament
Material: Glass (or glass-look plastic depending on manufacturer finish—appears metallic-coated)
Year: 1994 box / 1980 artwork
Country of Manufacture: USA
